narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to parts of New Jersey on the afternoon and evening of July 17. Rainfall totals were as high as 4 to 6 inches in Hunterdon County and Somerset County.
ev: A water rescue took place in the Oak Grove section of Franklin Township.
A water rescue took place along Pleasant Run Road in Readington Township.
Widespread roadway flooding occurred in Hillsborough Township. US Route 206 became impassable at Camplain Road. A water rescue took place along Amwell Road at Blackpoint Road.
Widespread roadway flooding in Ewing Township with some roads becoming impassable.
Whiskey Lane in Delaware Township became impassable due to flood waters.
Widespread roadway flooding in Hopewell Township with some roads becoming impassable.
Moderate flooding occurred along the North Branch of the Raritan River near its confluence with the South Branch in Branchburg and in Bridgewater Township.
Warner Road in Springfield Township became impassable due to flood waters.

There was widespread roadway flooding in Raritan Township and in Flemington. Sections of US Route 202 southbound were closed. Three vehicles were stranded in the flood waters along Old York Road near the Neshanic River. Significant flooding was indicated by the river gauge at Reaville on the Neshanic River.
